weights_source: GSS CPI bulletins, Weight column of Tables 3-4 (April 2022, then '2018 = 100' series; identical in May 2022). Sums to 100.02 (rounding). Weights come from the 2016/17 GLSS 7 (weight reference 2017, per GSS as reported by Adom, 10 Jun 2026); the series is now published as 'New Series (2021 = 100)' (cover of the September 2024 bulletin) after the price reference was moved to 2021 to cover the six new regions. No rebased weights published as of 28 Oct 2026: GSS targets mid-2027. Note: GSS releases in 2026 quote food at 42.7 % (vs 43.12 here), so the 2021 = 100 division weights may differ slightly — to be confirmed.
title_fr: Indice expérimental des prix à la consommation
